copyChanges: Primary text: 'and a shell pearl' became 'and shell pearls', because the picture (and the listing photos, products.md flag) shows two pearls per stud. 149 characters; the offer ('BUY2: 10% off 2 pieces.') ends at character 123. Meta headline 40 (product, price, offer), description 29.

Lint against RULINGS: no diamond, real or solid gold, freshwater, bare 'gold' or 'silver' as the metal (only '18k gold tone'), 'emerald' only as 'emerald-green' (never a noun), 'pearl' only as 'shell pearls', no compare-at price (listing ₹1,289 not printed), no free shipping, no waterproof, tarnish-free or hypoallergenic claim and no water imagery (allowed for this SKU, not used). BUY2 10% on 2+ and BUY3 20% on 3+ match RULINGS §2; two codes, so 'Codes'. Stock 32 (20+). The UTM landing URL is the only URL; it carries no signature.

Layout departures from the brief, all logged above: P 58 not 52 (verifier and skeptic); H1 90 and beat 54 (0.60x) instead of 84 and 52; beat green #08C694 instead of the verifier's #15DCA9 (both sampled from the stones' lit facets); card top 958 instead of 940; offer separator in the beat green; Story beat dropped (brief rule) and the Story H1 on one line at 72 instead of two.

Fixer after critics round 1 (critic B, compliance): Meta description 'Emerald-green · 18k gold tone' became 'Emerald-green cubic zirconia' (28 characters, under the 30 limit), the RULINGS §1.1 wording, so the colour word never stands alone where it could read as a stone name. Meta only; no image change, the JPGs are unchanged.

Not applied (one critic only, logged for the lead): A's selective-colour type (Feed H1 'One bold ear / is enough.' with BOLD in #08C694, the beat in bone, and BOLD in #08C694 on the Story H1; A's test render tmp/criticA/t43_feed.jpg); B's optional A/B headline 'THE ONLY COLOUR / IN THE ROOM.' (Velista 90 bone, left 72, top 96), with the current headline kept as the control. Both critics found that the selective-colour device does not read from the picture alone (the white petals read as a naturally black-and-white set), but they asked for different remedies, and B kept the current headline as the control, so neither remedy is a shared fix. The lead's call: route A's colour fix to B, or B's A/B as a separate ad, in round 2.

Fixer after critics round 1 on b04-3h (20 Nov; both critics asked for it): the Meta primary text shared by b04-3 and b04-3h opened "One bold ear is enough:", the misread over a pair that both critics flagged and the line the b04-3h headline exists to drop. Both arms now open neutrally with the critics' own wording, identical in both so the live split still isolates the on-image headline: "Verdant Circlet Studs, ₹899: emerald-green cubic zirconia and shell pearls. BUY2: 10% off 2 pieces. For the wedding function." 125 characters (was 149); the offer ends at character 99 (was 123). Lint: no banned word; "emerald-green cubic zirconia" and "shell pearls" as before; no claim; ₹899 and BUY2 10% on 2+ as RULINGS §2. Meta headline, description, CTA and URL unchanged. Meta text only: no image changed.
truthNotes: Construction matches the pack ref (verifier and skeptic): per stud the green cushion stone tilted at the circlet's upper edge, 5 claw-set clear cubic zirconia, exactly 2 four-point stars and 2 pearls (the big one a round bead), the centre open; true mirror images; 18k gold tone, hue 71, not brassy.

Scale: 24.7 Feed px per listed mm (stud 415 Feed px for 16.8 mm), about 1.5-1.6x life on a phone, so 'Shown magnified · about 16.8 mm tall' prints on both formats. Pair 69.3% of the Feed width (1.195x the 58% shareLine, inside the 1.2x bar). Circlet / stone 1.52 and pearl / stone 0.45 follow the pack ref (1.51, 0.42).

Posts render steel-grey and act as legs (the selective-colour device drained them, C* 2.5); at Feed size they read as posts. The petals read as generic white petals, not marigold, so the world can read as naturally monochrome; the green beat and 'only the studs are in colour' carry the device.
No face, skin, hands, water, other jewellery or text in the picture.
